name: Your Company
tagline: A bookshop where the bookseller has read what they recommend
niche: Bookshop: fiction, non-fiction, children’s books, a book club

listing.description: A website for a bookshop, publisher or library. Book spines on a shelf, covers of new arrivals, quotes in large italics and a book club schedule.

seo.title: Your Company — bookshop on Tashkent’s Broadway
seo.description: Books in Russian, Uzbek and English: fiction, non-fiction and children’s. Thursday book club, any book ordered in 7–14 days, gift cards and delivery across Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company is an independent bookshop at 9 Sayilgoh Street (Broadway) in Tashkent, open daily 10:00–21:00. About 12,000 books in Russian, Uzbek and English; anything not on the shelf can be ordered in 7–14 days. The book club meets Thursdays at 19:00 — 50,000 sum including tea. Delivery in Tashkent is 25,000 sum, free over 300,000 sum.

sections.title: A good book finds its reader
sections.subtitle: Twelve thousand books in three languages, an armchair by the window and booksellers who’ll help you choose — by your mood, not by ratings.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A shop to linger in
sections.text: Your Company opened in 2018 in an old house on Broadway: wooden shelves up to the ceiling, a library ladder and a big table where you can read without buying. We choose every book on the shelves ourselves and write handwritten cards for them. If the book you want isn’t here, we’ll order it in.

items.title: Bygone Days
items.text: The first Uzbek novel in a new design.

items.title: Klara and the Sun
items.text: A quiet novel about love through a machine’s eyes.

items.title: Sapiens
items.text: A brief history of humankind — the non-fiction book of the decade.

items.title: The Little Prince
items.text: A gift edition with the author’s watercolours.

items.title: Book club
items.text: Every Thursday at 19:00 we discuss the book of the month over tea. The season’s list is on our Telegram channel.

items.title: Order any book
items.text: We’ll bring in a book we don’t stock from Russia, Europe or Turkey.

items.title: Gift cards
items.text: From 100,000 sum, valid for a year. We’ll wrap it in kraft paper and write the card.

items.title: Children’s readings
items.text: Saturdays at 11:00 we read aloud to kids aged 4–8 and draw what we’ve read.

items.quote: I asked for “something like Chekhov but about now” and in two minutes they found me three books. I read all three.
items.author: Malika

items.quote: I’ve been coming to the club for two years. It’s the only thing that gets me reading a book a month again.
items.author: Farkhod

items.q: Can I order a book you don’t have?
items.a: Yes — send us the title or a link and we’ll quote a price and timing, usually 7–14 days. No prepayment needed.
In Tashkent, 25,000 sum by courier on the day you order, free over 300,000 sum. To the regions by post.

items.q: How do I join the book club?
items.a: Message us on Telegram to book a seat — there are 40. The book of the month is 10% off in the shop.
Our second-hand section takes books in good condition on Fridays, valued on the spot.

sections.label: Order
sections.title: Looking for a book?
sections.text: Send us a title, or just describe what you’d like to read — we’ll reply within the hour and put the book aside at the till.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Books
sections.text: Add to cart and check out — we will call to confirm and deliver.
